results_section: 1. The dual-expert model achieves a 17.6% reduction in KL divergence for the complex 'dino' dataset, from 1.060 to 0.873.
2. KL divergence reduction of 1.1% for the 'circle' dataset (Dual-Expert vs. Baseline).
3. KL divergence reduction of 8.4% for the 'moons' dataset (Dual-Expert vs. Baseline).
4. Training time increased by an average of 45% across all datasets for the dual-expert model compared to baseline.
5. Inference time increased by an average of 42% for the dual-expert model compared to baseline.
6. The introduction of the diversity loss term results in a 38.7% reduction in KL divergence from baseline on the 'dino' dataset (from 1.060 to 0.650).
